Class LobbyUpdatePayload

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.shared.payload.servertoclient.lobby.LobbyUpdatePayload
All Implemented Interfaces:
LobbyServerPayload, ServerPayload, Serializable
public class LobbyUpdatePayload extends Object implements Serializable, LobbyServerPayload
Payload sent by the server to notify players in a lobby of any state changes.

This contains the event type, target nickname, message alerts, updated member list, lobby capacity, current host details, and the totem color chosen by each player currently seated in the lobby.

  • Constructor Details

    • LobbyUpdatePayload

      public LobbyUpdatePayload(LobbyEventType event, String nickname, String message, Integer lobbyId, List<String> players, String hostNickname, Integer maxPlayers, Map<String, TotemColor> playerTotemColors)
      Constructs a new LobbyUpdatePayload including the player-to-totem association.

      When the update is a direct confirmation to the player who left the lobby, the lobby state may be intentionally empty. In that case a null color map is normalized to an empty map.

      Parameters:
      event - the type of the lobby event
      nickname - the player nickname involved
      message - descriptive text message
      lobbyId - the identifier of the lobby
      players - the list of current lobby members
      hostNickname - the nickname of the current host
      maxPlayers - the maximum capacity of the lobby
      playerTotemColors - map from player nickname to selected totem color
